title: 樹上横丁｜入口広場の空欄パネル
titleEn: TreeTop Yokocho | Entry Plaza Blank Control Panel
description: 緑の二重枠を描いた生成りの空欄パネル。操作ボタンや文字は含みません。 クランプ用でシームレスではありません。原画像と縦横比を維持。 ベースカラーのみ。
descriptionEn: Natural-paper-colored blank panel with a green double border. No buttons, controls or text are included. Clamp to edge; not seamless. Original image and aspect ratio preserved. Basecolor only.

provenance.verification: Original PNG copied byte-for-byte with matching SHA256.
provenance.rights: Xenoah original authored assets. The owner requested publication of their original models and textures in Meshcopia under its CC BY 4.0 rules. External scan images, font software, third-party SDKs and runtime behaviors are not redistributed.
provenance.changes: Original PNG copied byte-for-byte. Separate actual-artwork thumbnail. Mirror surfaces require alternating flipped tiles; clamp artworks retain authored aspect ratio and are not tileable.

previewDescription: Full original image fitted without cropping or aspect distortion.
